name: gpu-deep-vgg
description: The deeper VGGs (VGG-7 and VGG-9, fused pools), kept out of gpu_campaign.json on purpose. Two things come first. (1) The layer layouts need the sponsor's sign-off; if the sponsor wants a different layout (for example pcx's VGG-7 paddings), change the rows before running this. (2) At 8 settling steps sPC only lines up with backprop in the top 3 or 4 convs, so each depth starts with a short, 1-seed sPC probe. Run the probes on their own first: python -m fabricpc.bench queue fabricpc/bench/plans/gpu_deep_vgg.json --out ~/runs/gpu-deep-vgg --only cifar10-vgg7-spc,cifar10-vgg9-spc. Look at their accuracy (and tune the settling rate or step count if sPC barely learns) before running the full families.
